concerns.text: The pipeline relies on a 'Kaggle GPU escape hatch' for CodeLlama generation when CPU inference exceeds 30 s per snippet. This introduces an external compute dependency that is not guaranteed to be available within the free‑compute constraints of the llmXive platform (GitHub Actions runners have no GPU). The plan must either ensure all generation completes on CPU within the 6 h wall‑time budget or replace the GPU fallback with a fully CPU‑tractable model/approach.
